description: Plan T16, step 4. The Renovate GitHub app is installed on the repo (G3, 2026-10-15).

packageRules.description: Medusa's packages move together; the backend and the JS SDK must be the same version.
Payload and its adapters must all be one version (check:workspace guards it). e2e-smoke, with the payload-admin suite, runs on every PR, this one included.
D4: Next.js is pinned exactly and each release is tested before it merges. eslint-config-next is released with Next and moves with it. e2e-smoke runs on every PR, so the admin suite runs on these.
D5: TypeScript 5.9.3. TS 7 has no JS API until 7.1; Medusa's CLI and typescript-eslint need one.
ESLint stays on 9.39.5 until the Medusa plugin allows 10 (SETUP.md, T02 item 1).
@types/node follows the Node line the repo runs on (22), not the latest.
engines.pnpm is below 13 and pnpm/action-setup@v6 supports pnpm 12 and earlier: a pnpm major is a change of its own, made by hand together with both.
Node's line is chosen in .nvmrc and engines (a major is a decision of its own, Medusa and Payload both state which they support).
A new major of Postgres, Redis, Meilisearch or Mailpit is a data migration for everyone who has a volume; do that by hand.
